powpow/net/tlsapi.nim — Minimal OpenSSL bindings used by powpow's TLS layer.

Unlike std/openssl (which dlopens a versioned libssl at runtime and can accidentally mix libraries), this module declares the handful of OpenSSL entry points powpow needs and links libssl/libcrypto directly at compile time, so the whole process always uses a single, deterministic TLS library.

The bindings are declared with {.importc.} and no header, so they work as long as the linker can find -lssl -lcrypto (system, Homebrew, MacPorts, ...).

Consts

SSL_CTRL_SET_TLSEXT_HOSTNAME = 55
SSL_set_tlsext_host_name is a macro over SSL_ctrl in OpenSSL 1.1.1+/3, so it is not linkable; use SSL_ctrl with this command for SNI.
